messages:
Nina (Product): Quick heads-up: private/on-prem 1.2.0 is GA and available for customers today. Key highlights: air-gap friendly installer, FIPS-compatible crypto toggle, richer audit streaming for compliance teams, and upgraded HSM adapters. Release notes here: https://internal.redwood.ai/private/1.2.0-release

Diego (Eng): Release uploaded to internal-artifacts/private/1.2.0 (sha256: d4c9e8...). Offline installer now includes a compact dependency bundle and a new --skip-network-check flag for isolated installs. See the 'Air-gapped deployments' section in the runbook.

Priya (Security): Compliance summary: enabling --fips-mode switches the crypto provider to the validated module and turns on additional key wrapping logs. We added structured audit events (JSON lines) to make ingestion into SIEMs straightforward. Customers using customer-managed HSMs should verify provider versions against the KMS compatibility matrix. I'll add a short FAQ for common HSM vendors.

Liam (Solutions): I'll coordinate SE support slots for the first two weeks of GA. Can we publish a migration compatibility list for customers currently on 1.0/1.1?

Nina (Product): Yes 1 migration script included: tools/private-migrate-1x-to-1-2.sh. It preserves model pins, rollout policies, and config secrets (encrypted). We documented failure modes and rollback steps in the upgrade checklist.

Diego (Eng): Note: enabling FIPS reduces throughput on some older CPU platforms due to the fallback crypto path. Benchmarks: median token throughput down ~12% on Broadwell-class hosts. We call this out in the perf appendix.

Priya (Security): Action for sales/SEs: add the audit-scope checkbox to all Private engagements and attach the SOC2-ready audit checklist we put in the security docs. Also remind customers to confirm their KMS/HSM firmware levels before upgrade.

release-bot: Canary rollout started to selected Dedicated customers. Monitoring channel: #eng-monitoring.

Nina (Product): We'll run a customer webinar Thursday 2026-04-09 9am PT and record it. SE booking link: https://calendly.com/redwood/private-ga-se. Please add any customers who want a scheduled dry-run to the shared spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood.ai/private-ga-requests

Liam (Solutions): :thumbsup: scheduling first dry-run with a regulated customer next Monday. Will share the postmortem notes.

Diego (Eng): Posting the upgrade runbook + verification script to #eng-oncall and pinning. If you need custom build artifacts for an air-gapped install, ping me.

Nina (Product): TL;DR: GA live, air-gap & FIPS support, migration script included, SE support + webinar scheduled. React with :rocket: if you're on migration duty and put blocked customers in the spreadsheet.

Priya (Security): Thanks all. I'll follow up with the HSM compatibility FAQ and the SOC2 evidence template by EOD.

Nina (Product): Thanks team!
